title: Why the Vatican Burns Ballots to Announce a New Pope
asof: Rules from Universi Dominici Gregis (1996) · May 2025 conclave · full video on the channel

shots.s: The whole world watches one little chimney.
Inside the Sistine Chapel, cardinals are choosing a pope.
Each one writes a name on a paper ballot.
They're told to disguise their handwriting.
To win, someone needs two thirds of the votes.
After the votes, the ballots go into a stove.
Black smoke means no pope yet.
In May 2025, the first night's smoke was black.
The next afternoon, on the fourth vote, it turned white.
The new pope was Leo the Fourteenth, the first from the United States.
Would you wait in the square for the smoke?
